scene: The wooden carriage rattles upward while glowing moth-lanterns sway gently overhead.
beats: Inside rests a mechanical compass aimed at the stars. As the car reaches Comet Watch Rooftop and the doors slide open, the needle twitches with excitement.
You tighten a loose valve, earning a warm grin and a shiny brass comet token just as the funicular brakes at Comet Watch Rooftop and the doors roll open.
A starry messenger bird hops out, drops a folded constellation chart into your palm, and flutters ready by the doorway as Comet Watch Rooftop slides into view and opens.
picture: A flat side view inside the rising funicular carriage. On the left, an open bench holds a small velvet case. The player stands left-of-centre in his orange corduroy jacket. In the centre, the conductor fiddles with a brass gear pedestal. On the right, a sleepy passenger sits above a rustling woven basket.
shown: a tiny latched velvet case sitting on an empty wooden bench on the left
a uniformed conductor adjusting glowing brass gears at the control pedestal in the centre
a woven pigeon basket trembling softly beneath a passenger's seat on the right

after.beat: You stay put as the car glides past, humming through misty rails until the terminus. Transferring to the clattering mail train, you roll right into the cavernous, toy-heaped Lost Property Depot.
after.then: Step off at Lost Property Depot

variants.scene: Moth lamps hum softly as the funicular climbs into the purple evening sky.
beats: You unlatch the tiny box to find a mechanical compass. Its needle quivers toward the sky as the car reaches Comet Watch Rooftop and the doors slide open.
You steady a spinning cog on the pedestal. The conductor beams, gifting you a brass token just as the car slows at Comet Watch Rooftop and doors open wide.
A speckled pigeon wiggles free, nudging a tiny paper star map into your fingers. It flaps beside you as the tram reaches Comet Watch Rooftop and the doors part.
variants.ride_on: You remain aboard through the quiet mountain mist. Switching onto the rumbling mail train at the final stop, you clatter straight into the sprawling Lost Property Depot.
